title: Route 23 & Victory Road
subtitle: Final rival battle before the League, badge gates, boulder puzzles

steps.text: Route 22: Rival battle 7 at the gate. Pidgeot Lv.47, Rhyhorn Lv.45, Gyarados/Growlithe/Exeggcute Lv.45, Alakazam Lv.47, starter Lv.53. Be around Lv.45+.
Route 23: guards check each badge in turn. Surf across the water, then walk north through the grass (Fearow, Arbok, Sandslash, Ditto). Eight hidden items along the way.
Victory Road needs Strength (boulders onto switches to open doors) and ideally Flash-free eyes — it is lit. Bring Repels; Machoke, Golbat, Onix, Marowak, Graveler inside.
Victory Road 1F: push the boulder onto the switch to open the path north.
2F: two boulder switches; Double-Edge Move Tutor near the west side (once).
3F: the last boulder puzzle and the strongest trainers, then back to 2F east and out.
Indigo Plateau: Pokémon Center and Mart (buy Full Restores, Revives, Hyper Potions, Ultra Balls). Save before entering.
